purpose: Allow one addressed FIELD object to admit unequal physical/virtual projections without multiplying canonical state, authority, queues, routes, or workflows.

kernel.canonical_flow: OBJECT -> ADDRESS -> STATE -> PROJECTION -> OPERATOR -> WITNESS -> RETURN
kernel.invariant: Projection may reveal, compress, orient, or stage an already-owned object; it may not create domain meaning, authority, priority, or hidden mutation.
acceptance: same object identity survives projection change
same source/target authority survives projection change
one gesture has one primary host-defined interpretation
projection-only state can be discarded without losing canonical object state
RETURN names the projection only as evidence about representation
no projection earns promotion without reducing confusion or increasing lawful re-entry

PLAIN.function: Minimal linear reading of the same held mission; removes glyph/topological detail while preserving title, brief, action, evidence and RETURN.

FIELD.function: Addressed FIELD reading using existing glyph/presentation grammar over the same mission/object.

FLOWER.function: Runtime reading of a transformation without creating another workflow.

mapping.LOOP: repeat the bounded host run only when a prior RETURN authorizes a fresh replan
mapping.ELEVATION: optional derived principle/invariant; never required to RETURN
mapping.GATE: authority/evidence boundary around the sequence, not an extra petal or state store

ASCENT.law: Higher abstraction is earned only when the lower representation emits evidence; ascent is a reading depth, never status, rank, spirituality score, or authority.
ASCENT.residue: The cultural/historical monument is not claimed to encode this modern nine-step compiler exactly; only the traversal/compression invariant is transferred.

FU.function: Expose one object through composable ports rather than a new object store.
FU.physical_virtual_rule: Physical cube/room and virtual node are equivalent only when they preserve the same state contracts and RETURN path; matching geometry alone is insufficient.

RADIAL.function: Angle/radius/ring/center may encode host-owned relations only through explicit mappings.
RADIAL.law: COAXIALITY != CONCENTRICITY; generic geometry exposes coordinates/relations, host owns semantic verbs.

first_experiment.question: For the exact same real mission, does FIELD or PLAIN produce the better lawful re-entry and consequence?
first_experiment.caveat: Subjective ratings characterize representation fit; they do not prove mission correctness or global interface superiority.

exclusions: no automatic promotion from subjective score
no cultural claim that modern projection grammar is the historical meaning of Borobudur
no geometry-derived domain verb without an explicit host map
